Requests: Issue HTTP requests from DuckDB SQL. [`http_get`](#http_get) for reads, [`http_post`](#http_post) for JSON-body POSTs, [`http_post_form`](#http_post_form) for `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` POSTs, [`http_head`](#http_head) for headers only, and (DuckDB 2.0) [`http_put`](#http_put) and [`http_delete`](#http_delete). Each returns a JSON object with `status`, `reason`, and `body` (plus the response `headers` on DuckDB 2.0).
